description: This file defines the SandboxDatabaseUpdatesValidator class, which implements event subscription to check for staged database updates in Drupal extensions, and provides methods to detect changes in update functions within module and theme directories.

classes.name: SandboxDatabaseUpdatesValidator
classes.description: A validator class that checks for database updates in staged extensions and issues warnings if updates are detected.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies: PathLocator, ModuleExtensionList, ThemeExtensionList.

methods.name: checkForStagedDatabaseUpdates
methods.description: Checks if there are database updates in the staged directory and adds a warning if so.

methods.name: hasStagedUpdates
methods.description: Determines if a staged extension has changed update functions compared to the active extension.

methods.name: getUpdateFunctions
methods.description: Retrieves update function names from a module or theme directory by parsing relevant files.

methods.name: tokensMatchFunctionNamePattern
methods.description: Checks if a set of tokens contains a function name matching a specific pattern.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this class subscribes to, specifically StatusCheckEvent.

methods.name: getExtensionsWithDatabaseUpdates
methods.description: Returns a list of extensions that have database updates in the staged directory.
